# Data Exploration

## Read in permit locations (CSV to dataframe)

NOTE: set the working directory to a local folder with the "clean1625_Wilmington.csv" with your personal drive (due to large file size with 75245 observations and 106 variable attributes)
```{r Load required libraries, error=F, warning=F}
# install.packages("lubridate")
# install.packages("tidyverse")
# install.packages("shiny")
# install.packages("gt")
library(tidyverse);library(here);library(gt)
library(sf);library(mapview);library(leaflet)

# Check working directory
#setwd()
getwd()

# Load CSV file from personal desktop folder into R
clean_orm_Wilmington <- read.csv("C:/Duke_MEM_MP_2026_2027_CWA_Data_Viz/clean1625_Wilmington.csv")

# Filter for last RIA period (2021-2025) to reflect updates from ORM SOP 2021
NC_post_2021 <- clean_orm_Wilmington %>%
  filter(fiscal_year %in% c(2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025))
```

## Check id types and counts to determine best for analysis

Notes from ORM Data Dictionary and ORM FOIA Data Caveats document
- *action_folder_id* = Unique ID number (7 digits, ex: 1177355) for the Department of the Army folder number. Folder usually has multiple related permit actions. 

- *action_id* = unique permits, but note that there may be multiple permits for an individual project - a project may use multiple NWPs, or a project gives a unique action_id for each water crossing for a pipeline for example. 

- *impact_id* = Unique ID number (7 digits, ex: 1980514) that is associated with an impact. Impact and mitigation records are not linked 1:1.

- *mitigation_id* = There can be multiple mitigation_id's associated with one action_id

- *DA_number* = Best to use action_folder_id or da_number to count number of "projects". There will be multiple action_id's (and also potentially impact_id, mitigation_id) within one folder/DA#.
```{r Select date column best for calculating permit timeframes, error=F, warning=F}
# Check to see which dates to use for analysis
id_counts <- NC_post_2021 %>%
  group_by(fiscal_year) %>%
  summarise(
    action_folder_id = sum(!is.na(action_folder_id)),
    action_id = sum(!is.na(action_id)),
    impact_id = sum(!is.na(impact_id)),
    mitigation_id = sum(!is.na(mitigation_id)),
    da_number = sum(!is.na(da_number) & da_number != ""),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(Fiscal_Year = fiscal_year)

# no NA values
id_counts %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Record Counts by Fiscal Year",
    subtitle = "Wilmington ORM Data"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    Fiscal_Year = "Fiscal Year",
    action_folder_id = "Action Folder ID",
    action_id = "Action ID",
    impact_id = "Impact ID",
    mitigation_id = "Mitigation ID",
    da_number = "DA Number"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = -Fiscal_Year,
    decimals = 0
  )

id_counts
# The number of permit actions is the same as the number of permit projects. Choose to use the da_number because it has a shorter column name and has the same number of permits as Action_folder_ID and DA_Number for all five fiscal years. 
```

## Check date types and counts to determine best for analysis

Notes from ORM Data Dictionary and ORM FOIA Data Caveats document
- *begin_date* = Do not use in calculating permit timelines - this is the date that the *action_id* was created (if I understand correctly), and this could be the date of a pre-application consultation, jurisdictional determination, etc. 

- *permit_end_date* = Date USACE transmitted a permit decision. received stamped on the last piece of information needed to complete the Public Notice for an Individual Permit or to complete the application for a General Permit.

- *federally_complete_date* = Use this in calculating permit timeframes - this is when the application is deemed complete and officially starts the clock on any processing deadlines. Date that a federally complete permit application/request was received by USACE.

- *end_date* = permit action end date 

- *recieved_date* = Do not use in calculating whether permit timelines are meeting deadlines for processing time. Could be used to indicate if there was a lot of back and forth requests before an application was deemed 'complete' by the Corps. 
```{r Select date column best for calculating permit timeframes, error=F, warning=F}
# Check to see which dates to use for analysis
NC_post_2021 <- NC_post_2021 %>%
  mutate(
    begin_date = dmy(begin_date),
    permit_end_date = dmy(permit_end_date),
    federally_complete_date = dmy(federally_complete_date),
    end_date = dmy(end_date),
    received_date = dmy(received_date)
  )

#glimpse(NC_post_2021)
#head(NC_post_2021$begin_date)

date_counts <- NC_post_2021 %>%
  group_by(fiscal_year) %>%
  summarise(
    begin_date = sum(!is.na(begin_date)),
    permit_end_date = sum(!is.na(permit_end_date)),
    federally_complete_date = sum(!is.na(federally_complete_date)),
    end_date = sum(!is.na(end_date)),
    received_date = sum(!is.na(received_date))
  ) %>%
  rename(Fiscal_Year = fiscal_year)

date_counts %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Permit Counts by Fiscal Year",
    subtitle = "Wilmington ORM Data"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    Fiscal_Year = "Fiscal Year",
    begin_date = "Begin Date",
    permit_end_date = "Permit End Date",
    federally_complete_date = "Federal Complete Date",
    end_date = "End Date",
    received_date = "Received Date"
  )

date_counts
# Choose to use the end_date column for consistency due to complete data for all five years
```

## May want to filter if only interested in 404 permits

Clean Water Act permit authority used in permit verification/issuance, for example: "Section 404", "Section 10/404", "Section 10", "Section 103", "Section 10/404/103" [combination of permits], "Section 10/103" [combination of permits], "Section 9", "Section 404/103" [combination of permits]  
```{r Permit Authority Count, error = F, warning = F}
NC_post_2021 %>%
  count(permit_authority, sort = TRUE) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(permit_authority, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = n),
    hjust = -0.2,
    size = 4
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Permit Authority Counts (FY2021-2025)",
    x = "Permit Authority",
    y = "Number of Permits"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  expand_limits(y = max(table(NC_post_2021$permit_authority)) * 1.1)
```

## Difference between action_id (unique permits) and da_number (unique projects)

Notes whether the permittee is responsible for the long term mitigation monitoring of the mitigation site.
- If want to know *# of unique permits* where permittee responsible mitigation was used (and NOT # of sub-actions like impact or impacts &/or mitigation all associated with the same permit), count the unique # of action_id rows where "mitigation_permittee_rsp" = "All" OR "Some". 
Permit Actions: "How many permits required permittee mitigation?"

- If you want to know *unique # of projects* (many projects like pipelines have multiple permits/action_id's), count unique action_folder_id or da_number where "mitigation_permittee_rsp" = "All" OR "Some". 
Projects: "How many distinct development/infrastructure projects required permittee mitigation?"
```{r Responsible mitigation permittee count, error = F, warning = F}
mitigation_fy <- NC_post_2021 %>%
  filter(mitigation_permittee_rsp %in% c("All", "Some")) %>%
  distinct(fiscal_year, da_number, mitigation_permittee_rsp) %>% #Counts each DA number only once per fiscal year and mitigation category.
  count(fiscal_year, mitigation_permittee_rsp) # Counts the number of unique DA numbers in each category.

ggplot(
  mitigation_fy,
  aes(y = factor(fiscal_year),
      x = n,
      fill = mitigation_permittee_rsp)
) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = n),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    color = "white"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Unique Action IDs by Mitigation Responsibility",
    x = "Unique Action IDs",
    y = "Fiscal Year",
    fill = "Mitigation Responsibility"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

## No change in unique action_id nor da_number for mitigation responsibility
```

# Data Cleaning

```{r Data Cleaning, error=F, warning=F}
# Filter more columns
NC_post2021 <- NC_post_2021 %>%
  select(
    da_number,
    action,
    action_type,
    permit_authority,
    compensatory_mitigation_rqd,
    mitigation_permittee_rsp,
    end_date,
    federally_complete_date,
    proj_latitude,
    proj_longitude,
    impact_duration,
    impact_perm_loss,
    impact_type,
    waters_latitude,
    waters_longitude,
    auth_fill_acres,
    auth_struc_acres,
    auth_drg_fill_acres,
    auth_drg_remvl_acres,
    mit_req_acres,
    fiscal_year
  )

# Action type
NC_post2021$action_type <- as.factor(NC_post2021$action_type)

# Display the structure of the dataframe (n = 42009 obs of 20 variables)
str(NC_post2021)
class(NC_post2021)

# Convert the dataframe to an sf dataframe. Difference between proj and waters coordinates?
sum(is.na(NC_post2021$proj_longitude))
sum(is.na(NC_post2021$proj_latitude))
# na values = 1

sum(is.na(NC_post2021$waters_longitude))
sum(is.na(NC_post2021$waters_latitude))
# na values = 12780

# Converts ORM dataframe into an sf (simple features) spatial object using the longitude and latitude coordinates.
NC_proj <- NC_post2021 %>%
  filter(!is.na(proj_longitude),
         !is.na(proj_latitude)) %>%
  st_as_sf(
    coords = c("proj_longitude", "proj_latitude"),
    crs = 4269
  )

NC_waters <- NC_post2021 %>%
  filter(!is.na(waters_longitude),
         !is.na(waters_latitude)) %>%
  st_as_sf(
    coords = c("waters_longitude", "waters_latitude"),
    crs = 4269
  )

# NOTE: NC County Boundary found under repository "Data" folder
NC_county <- vect("Data/NC_County_Boundary/County_Boundary.shp")
NC_county <- project(NC_county, crs(NC_waters))
NC_county <- st_as_sf(NC_county)

# NOTE: NC HUC8 Watershed Boundary found under repository "Data" folder
NC_HUC8 <- vect("Data/NC_HUC_8_Boundary/NC_HUC_8.shp")
NC_HUC8 <- project(NC_HUC8, crs(NC_waters))
NC_HUC8 <- st_as_sf(NC_HUC8)

```

# Spatial Analysis

## Plot permit point locations by action overlapping HUC8 boundaries

```{r ggplot method, error=F, warning=F}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = NC_HUC8,
    fill = "blue",
    color = "white",
    alpha = 0.75,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = NC_proj,
    aes(color = action_type),
    size = 0.5
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "CWA Section 404 Permit Locations by Action Type in North Carolina from the Last RIA Period (1/4/2021-9/30/2025)",
    subtitle = "Created by Elizabeth Miles-Flynn",
    color = "Action Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r leaflet method, error=F, warning=F}
# Convert both layers to WGS84
NC_proj <- st_transform(NC_proj, 4326)
NC_HUC8 <- st_transform(NC_HUC8, 4326)

# Create palette
pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = "Set1",
  domain = NC_proj$action_type
)

leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%

  addPolygons(
    data = NC_HUC8,
    fillColor = "grey",
    fillOpacity = 0.1,
    color = "black",
    weight = 1
  ) %>%

  addCircleMarkers(
    data = NC_proj,
    color = ~pal(action_type),
    radius = 1,
    stroke = FALSE,
    fillOpacity = 0.5,
    popup = ~paste(
      "<b>Action Type:</b>", action_type,
      "<br><b>DA Number:</b>", da_number,
      "<br><b>Fiscal Year:</b>", fiscal_year
    )
  ) %>%

  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = pal,
    values = NC_proj$action_type,
    title = "Action Type"
  )
```

```{r Radius point changes by fill acres, error=F, warning=F}
## Plot auth_fill_acres by radius size
pal2 <- colorBin(
  palette = "viridis",
  domain = NC_proj_fill$auth_fill_acres,
   bins = c(
    0,
    0.1,
    0.5,
    1,

    5,

    25,
    50,
    100,
    200),

)

leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%

 addPolygons(
    data = NC_HUC8,
    fillColor = "grey",
    fillOpacity = 0.1,
    color = "black",
    weight = 1
  ) %>%

  addCircleMarkers(
    data = NC_proj_fill,

    # Size represents acreage
    radius = ~pmax(2, sqrt(auth_fill_acres)),

    # Color represents acreage bins

addLegend(
  position = "bottomright",

  values = NC_proj_fill$auth_fill_acres,
  title = "Authorized Fill Acres"
)
```

```{r Radius point changes by fill acres COMBINED, error=F, warning=F}
# Clean datasets
acre_bins <- c(
  0, 0.1, 0.5, 1, 2,
  5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 200, Inf
)

all_acres <- c(
  NC_proj$auth_fill_acres,
  NC_proj$auth_struc_acres,
  NC_proj$auth_drg_fill_acres,
  NC_proj$auth_drg_remvl_acres,
  NC_proj$mit_req_acres
)

all_acres <- all_acres[
  !is.na(all_acres) &
  all_acres > 0
]

pal <- colorBin(
  palette = "viridis",
  domain = all_acres,
  bins = acre_bins,
  reverse = TRUE,
  pretty = FALSE
)

leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%

  addPolygons(
    data = NC_HUC8,
    fillColor = "grey",
    fillOpacity = 0.1,
    color = "black",
    weight = 1,
    group = "HUC8 Boundaries"
  ) %>%

  # Authorized Fill Acres
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = NC_proj %>% filter(!is.na(auth_fill_acres), auth_fill_acres > 0),
    radius = ~pmax(2, sqrt(auth_fill_acres)),
    fillColor = ~pal(auth_fill_acres),
    color = ~pal(auth_fill_acres),
    fillOpacity = 0.5,
    weight = 1,
    group = "Authorized Fill Acres",
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>Authorized Fill Acres:</b> ", round(auth_fill_acres, 2),
      "<br><b>DA Number:</b> ", da_number
    )
  ) %>%

  # Authorized Structure Acres
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = NC_proj %>% filter(!is.na(auth_struc_acres), auth_struc_acres > 0),
    radius = ~pmax(2, sqrt(auth_struc_acres)),
    fillColor = ~pal(auth_struc_acres),
    color = ~pal(auth_struc_acres),
    fillOpacity = 0.5,
    weight = 1,
    group = "Authorized Structure Acres",
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>Authorized Structure Acres:</b> ",
      round(auth_struc_acres, 2)
    )
  ) %>%

  # Authorized Dredge Fill Acres
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = NC_proj %>% filter(!is.na(auth_drg_fill_acres),
                              auth_drg_fill_acres > 0),
    radius = ~pmax(2, sqrt(auth_drg_fill_acres)),
    fillColor = ~pal(auth_drg_fill_acres),
    color = ~pal(auth_drg_fill_acres),
    fillOpacity = 0.5,
    weight = 1,
    group = "Authorized Dredge Fill Acres"
  ) %>%

  # Authorized Dredge Removal Acres
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = NC_proj %>% filter(!is.na(auth_drg_remvl_acres),
                              auth_drg_remvl_acres > 0),
    radius = ~pmax(2, sqrt(auth_drg_remvl_acres)),
    fillColor = ~pal(auth_drg_remvl_acres),
    color = ~pal(auth_drg_remvl_acres),
    fillOpacity = 0.5,
    weight = 1,
    group = "Authorized Dredge Removal Acres"
  ) %>%

  # Mitigation Required Acres
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = NC_proj %>% filter(!is.na(mit_req_acres),
                              mit_req_acres > 0),
    radius = ~pmax(2, sqrt(mit_req_acres)),
    fillColor = ~pal(mit_req_acres),
    color = ~pal(mit_req_acres),
    fillOpacity = 0.5,
    weight = 1,
    group = "Mitigation Required Acres"
  ) %>%

  addLayersControl(
    overlayGroups = c(
      "HUC8 Boundaries",
      "Authorized Fill Acres",
      "Authorized Structure Acres",
      "Authorized Dredge Fill Acres",
      "Authorized Dredge Removal Acres",
      "Mitigation Required Acres"
    ),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) %>%

  hideGroup(c(
    "Authorized Structure Acres",
    "Authorized Dredge Fill Acres",
    "Authorized Dredge Removal Acres",
    "Mitigation Required Acres"
  )) %>%

  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = pal,
    values = all_acres,
    title = "Acres"
  )
```

## Plot total unique DA numbers per HUC8 watershed
``` {r spatial join, error=F, warning=F}
# Join permits to HUC8 polygons
permits_huc8 <- st_join(
  NC_proj,
  NC_HUC8,
  left = FALSE
)

# Count unique projects (DA numbers) per HUC8
huc8_counts <- permits_huc8 %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(HUC_8) %>%
  summarise(
    n_projects = n_distinct(da_number),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Join counts back to HUC8 layer
NC_HUC8_map <- NC_HUC8 %>%
  left_join(huc8_counts, by = "HUC_8")

NC_HUC8_map$n_projects[is.na(NC_HUC8_map$n_projects)] <- 0

# Create color palette
pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = "YlOrRd",
  domain = NC_HUC8_map$n_projects
)

leaflet(NC_HUC8_map) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%

  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal(n_projects),
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    color = "black",
    weight = 1,
    popup = ~paste(
      "<b>HUC8:</b>", HUC_8,
      "<br><b>Unique Projects:</b>", n_projects
    )
  ) %>%

  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = pal,
    values = ~n_projects,
    title = "Unique DA Numbers"
  )
```
